report_name: AI and Cloud Complexity Create New Risks for Manufacturers: Thales

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Used by attackers to access cloud resources after stealing credentials, as 57% of manufacturers reported an increase in credential theft attacks against their cloud environments.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Used as an initial contact method for sophisticated social engineering attacks, including deepfake vishing campaigns targeting the manufacturing sector.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage Object
attack_patterns.description: Used by attackers to access and steal sensitive, often unencrypted, data from cloud storage, which was identified as the top target (36%) in the manufacturing sector.

attack_patterns.name: Generate Deepfakes
attack_patterns.description: Used in attacks against 61% of manufacturers for social engineering, fraud, or disinformation, representing a significant AI-driven threat.

identities.name: Manufacturing Sector
identities.description: The subject of the 2026 Thales Data Threat Report, facing increased risks from AI-driven threats and cloud security gaps.

infrastructure.name: Cloud Storage
infrastructure.description: Identified as the top target for attackers (36%) against the manufacturing sector, often containing poorly encrypted sensitive data.

infrastructure.name: SaaS Applications
infrastructure.description: A primary target (29%) for attackers targeting manufacturers, susceptible to credential theft.

infrastructure.name: Cloud Management Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: A key target (26%) for attackers; compromise could lead to supply chain disruption.

indicators.name: Suspicious Cloud IAM Activity Monitoring
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Cloud IAM User or Role Creation
id: 2b9c1f8a-1e3d-4c5b-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: Monitors for the creation of new IAM users or roles with high privileges, which could indicate a privilege escalation attempt in a cloud environment.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/manufacturing/thales-2026-data-threat-report-finds-manufacturers-face-ai-and-cloud-security-risks-as-data-visibility-encryption-gaps-persist/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1078.004
level: medium
logsource:
  service: cloud-audit
  product: generic
detection:
  selection_create_user:
    event_name: 'CreateUser'
    responseElements.user.attachedManagedPolicies|contains:
      - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
  selection_create_role:
    event_name: 'CreateRole'
    requestParameters.assumeRolePolicyDocument|contains:
      - '"sts:AssumeRole"'
  condition: 1 of them
indicators.description: Detects suspicious IAM activity in cloud environments, such as the creation of new user accounts with high privileges, as suggested by the hunting hints in the report.

indicators.name: Anomalous Cloud Storage Access Pattern
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Cloud Storage Access
id: 8d7e6f5c-4b3a-4d2e-8f1a-9b8c7d6e5f4b
status: experimental
description: Detects when public access is enabled on a previously private cloud storage bucket or when large data downloads occur from unusual locations, which could indicate data exfiltration.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/manufacturing/thales-2026-data-threat-report-finds-manufacturers-face-ai-and-cloud-security-risks-as-data-visibility-encryption-gaps-persist/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1530
level: high
logsource:
  service: cloud-storage
  product: generic
detection:
  selection_public_access:
    event_name: 'PutBucketPublicAccessBlock'
    requestParameters.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.BlockPublicAcls: false
  selection_large_download:
    event_name: 'GetObject'
    additionalEventData.bytesTransferredOut|gt: 100000000
  condition: 1 of them
indicators.description: Detects anomalous access to cloud storage, such as enabling public access on private buckets or large data downloads from unusual locations, as suggested for hunting.

indicators.name: Suspicious AWS Cross-Account Role Assumption
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious AWS Cross-Account Role Assumption
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Monitors for the abuse of cross-account role assumption in AWS (sts:AssumeRole), which can be a sign of lateral movement in a cloud environment.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/manufacturing/thales-2026-data-threat-report-finds-manufacturers-face-ai-and-cloud-security-risks-as-data-visibility-encryption-gaps-persist/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1078.004
level: medium
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
detection:
  selection:
    eventSource: 'sts.amazonaws.com'
    eventName: 'AssumeRole'
  filter:
    sourceIPAddress|startswith:
      - '10.'
      - '172.16.'
      - '192.168.'
    userIdentity.invokedBy|contains:
      - 'amazonaws.com' # Filter known AWS services
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects abuse of AWS 'sts:AssumeRole' for cross-account access, a sign of lateral movement as highlighted in the hunting hints.

indicators.name: SaaS Impossible Travel Login
indicators.pattern:
title: SaaS Impossible Travel Login
id: f0e9d8c7-6b5a-4c3d-8e1f-0a9b8c7d6e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects impossible travel scenarios in SaaS application audit logs, such as logins from geographically distant locations in a short period of time.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/manufacturing/thales-2026-data-threat-report-finds-manufacturers-face-ai-and-cloud-security-risks-as-data-visibility-encryption-gaps-persist/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1078.004
level: high
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: saas
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: 'login'
    outcome: 'success'
    impossible_travel: true
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects impossible travel logins to SaaS applications, indicating potential credential compromise as suggested in the report's hunting hints.
